decisions.reason: The source changes bathroom arrangements in unit 1 and does not alter the unit 3 bathroom or its left-wall shower location.

Retaining and completing a bathroom may reject the prior toilet-removal option, but the source does not explicitly determine how the additional 6.8 m² vestibule area is used or whether the coat-storage alternative remains applicable.
The source concerns two bathrooms in unit 1 and does not change the position or door arrangement of the unit 2 bathroom.
Adding a shower in the red-marked unit 1 area does not explicitly change the existing drainage-alignment constraints or any recorded drain connection target.
The bathroom-door relocation in the source belongs to unit 1, not the unit 3 bathroom door and kitchen-counter clearance requirement.
The source changes unit 1 bathroom and interior-door arrangements without changing the unit 3 kitchen layout or its bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The referenced bathroom and room doors are interior doors; the source does not change the common steel entrance door or independent dwelling entrance doors.
The source specifies a shower and door relocations but does not explicitly add, remove, or reposition any partition wall.
The unit 1 bathroom proposal does not change the open-kitchen configuration or cabinet dimensions and placement.
Creating two independent unit 1 bathrooms, including an ensuite, does not change the three-dwelling count or the recorded 2+1 configuration of unit 1.
The source does not modify the common-corridor narrowing method or its 28 cm wall movement.
The unit 1 bathroom and door proposal does not change any unit 2 kitchen requirement.
